prompt.garment: a regular fit t-shirt in 240gsm textured knit (52% cotton / 48% polyester), {COR}, with tone-on-tone horizontal stripes of texture across the whole body and sleeves: smooth flat jersey bands about 8–10 mm tall alternating with slightly raised textured bands about 3–5 mm tall made of two or three tight rows of tiny bobble-like cells (a seed-stitch / popcorn micro-cell texture, like a knitted waffle), fully matte, set-in shoulders, short sleeves ending mid-bicep with a turned double-stitched hem, medium-width smooth crew-neck band, straight double-stitched hem at the hip, fully opaque
prompt.bottom: light-wash blue jeans with ripped distressing
prompt.colors: BGE/MRR? (light sand beige — fotos #1–3), PRT (black — #4–6), OFF (off-white — #7–9); MAR só no texto — confirmar
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-weight 240gsm knit with a tactile, hand-knit look — the raised cell bands give the surface an organic horizontal rhythm, like artisanal tricot produced industrially. Under the soft light the tiny cells catch individual pinpoint highlights and cast micro-shadows, so each textured band reads as a fine dotted relief line, while the smooth bands between them stay flat and even; the stripes are created only by texture, never by a color change. Matte, no sheen. Clean regular drape that neither clings nor balloons. Smooth collar band; reinforced seams; turned double-stitched hems; anti-torsion finish keeping the stripes perfectly level and parallel all around the body, continuing across the sleeves. Movement: where the arm bends or the fabric is pinched, the horizontal stripes curve and gather gently, the cells compress and the relief becomes more pronounced inside the fold.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep. Little stretch: the stripes stay straight and level across the chest.
